character:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production animation puppet PARTS SHEET on flat pure magenta #FF00FF. NO TEXT OR LABELS anywhere. Original 1960s made-for-TV Christmas cel cartoon: thin slightly wobbly black ink, flat cel fills, curly swoops, spindly anatomy, limited grey/red/sickly pale green/black palette. No character gradients. Entire figure STRICT RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE: slight young male holiday tech miser, short messy brown hair, ONE very large visible round eye, long angular nose, pale subtly fuzzy villain-green skin, tiny pointed ear, wide thin smug closed grin. Plain grey crewneck, long tattered red Victorian scarf, battered black top hat, fingerless grey wool gloves long bony green fingers, slim dark trousers, pointy curled slippers. ORIGINAL, not any existing holiday character.
Large high-resolution landscape sheet 3:2, clean separate cutout pieces spaced widely, nothing touching.
LAYOUT EXACTLY: left third contains ONE complete assembled character tiptoe sneaking right, hat to slipper visible, hunched. Middle third TOP contains ONE large isolated profile head with hat and neck, same closed grin as full reference; middle third BOTTOM contains ONE headless armless legless sweater torso with scarf, generous neck/shoulder/hip coverage. Right third contains EIGHT distinct isolated limb segments in a clean 2-column 4-row grid, all painted at same scale as full figure: row1 two grey sweater upper arms with rounded overlapping shoulder and elbow ends; row2 two bent forearms with glove and spindly raised fingers pointing right, rounded elbow overlap; row3 two slim dark upper thighs with rounded hip and knee ends; row4 two lower shins including curled black slippers pointing right, rounded knee ends. One pair back limbs slightly darker. Keep each single part entirely separate from neighbors, no connecting lines, no props, no floor shadows, no text. Magenta never within subject. Give full character about 1400 pixel height on a 2400x1600 sheet if possible.
background: Use case: historical-scene / illustration-story. Background painting only, no characters. Wide 16:9, target 2400x1350. Original 1960s made-for-TV Christmas cartoon background: thin wobbly black ink outlines, watercolor washes and dry brush on paper, curly swooping architecture, limited deep teal-blue night, lavender snow, holly red and warm window yellow. Interior dim cozy-sinister data center at night. Rows of tall narrow server racks on LEFT and RIGHT edges, with curly tops and tiny colored DOT lights only (no writing, no screen symbols). Large grand arched window centered, through it a snowy hill at night, distant small town of crooked little houses glowing far below, falling snow and big spiky stars. Snow caught on window ledge. Floor spans entire lower third uninterrupted and clear for character walking horizontally; low eye-level theatrical flat stage perspective. Warm small lighting accents, blue shadows. No foreground garland or foreground blocking objects. No text letters numbers logos or watermark anywhere. Painterly environment but flat stylized forms, never photoreal, never 3D.
foreground:

Solid pure magenta #FF00FF backdrop to chroma key. No magenta within objects. No text letters numbers logos. Wide landscape 3:2.
TWO completely separate assets, generous gap between:
LEFT THIRD: ONE tall slim almost black deep teal server rack silhouette, full height of sheet with margin, curling top, tiny subdued colored dot indicator lights only, a single hanging curly cable attached to right side. Rack designed to frame extreme left foreground, fully visible, about 1350px tall when scaled.
LOWER RIGHT TWO THIRDS: ONE long horizontal snowy window-sill / Christmas garland strip, full strip visible with clear margin. Swooping deep green evergreen garland with holly red berries and pointy holly leaves, snow-white snowcap with lavender shadows along top, dark teal thin sill below. Long wide continuous strip, about 6:1 width/height. Transparent spaces through garland should be magenta. No scenery behind either object, no cast shadows on background. LEFT panel same head with mouth moderately OPEN in smug speaking smile, dark burgundy mouth interior and small cream teeth. RIGHT panel same head with mouth WIDE open smug grin/speech shape, larger dark burgundy cavity cream upper teeth and muted red tongue. STRICT right-facing side profile. Both heads otherwise identical to reference: precise same silhouette, battered black hat, brown hair, single huge round eye, pointy ear, green skin, neck. Preserve style and colors: thin wobbly black lines, flat pale green cel skin, no gradients. No new accessories. ONLY mouth region and lower lip/chin changes to accommodate mouth shapes. Heads equal size and aligned, full hat and neck visible with generous margin. Landscape image.
